headline: Rashi Peripherals Limited board approves acquisition
sum: Rashi Peripherals Limited's board approved an acquisition on 23 June 2026, disclosed via NSE filing; specific target, consideration and deal structure not yet detailed in publicly accessible sources.
implication: Board approval signals move into implementation; investors and legal counsel should monitor for detailed disclosure of target identity, valuation, regulatory approvals (CCI if >₹5,000 cr or foreign acquiror, FIPB if overseas inbound) and any regulatory gating items in follow-on filings.
detail: Rashi Peripherals, a listed technology company, initiated acquisition proceedings with board approval on 23 June 2026. The NSE disclosed the board outcome. As of the search date, the target company name, transaction value, and structural mechanics (share purchase, asset purchase, merger) remain undisclosed in public filings accessible online. Standard M&A disclosure requirements under the LODR (2015) and company's articles will govern subsequent reporting.
